note: Colour themes for images with people (kind scene or action). Each image picks one theme. Rules: no theme twice in the same lesson, never the same theme on two images next to each other in the flow, and the theme's times must fit the moment in the prompt (a night phrase only gets a theme that allows night). When an item has no theme, code picks one at random under these rules and saves it on the image spec so a regenerate keeps it. Object images get no theme: they keep their natural colours on white paper.
